summary: Iteration 6 — Granular permissions / content authoring / lives lifecycle. Added 12 new backend tests across 6 classes (TestCoursesPermission, TestLessonOwnershipEdit, TestLivesLifecycle, TestStageInvariant, TestPermissionsMgmt, TestAnnouncements) — all pass. Full backend suite = 64 passed / 1 skipped (pre-existing expected skip). Frontend Playwright (mobile viewport) verified 15/15 UI checks: (a) formador Profile → Central do Formador exposes ann-title/ann-message/ann-submit and live-title/live-submit; publishing an announcement, creating and starting a live shows the '● AO VIVO' badge and end-{id} appears and ends the transmission; (b) mestre → Controle Mestre → master-perms-btn opens /app/mestre/permissoes listing perm-formador-* rows; opening one shows grouped perm-{PERM} checkboxes; toggling VIEW_ANALYTICS and clicking perm-save persists (verified state flip; restored to demo defaults); (c) membro dashboard shows 'Comunicados' section with published announcement-{id} cards; (d) membro is redirected away from both /app/formador and /app/mestre/permissoes. Backend covers: 403 on member/formador-without-perm create_course; 200 course create by demo formador; ownership rejection of PATCH /lessons/{id} by second formador without EDIT_ALL_CONTENT, then 200 after granting it; CREATE_LIVE without START_LIVE → create 200 but start 403; START_LIVE 200 + status='live' + 🔴 Ao vivo notification for stage-3 members; stage-1 (prevocacionado) does NOT see stage-3 live in any /api/lives bucket while stage-3 membro sees it in live_now; END_LIVE 200 with status='ended' and duration recorded; formador POST /master/users/{id}/stage → 403 (stage unchanged); MESTRE stage change requires non-empty reason (empty → 422); PUT /master/formadores/{id}/permissions filters unknown perms; only mestre can call GET/PUT permission endpoints; stage-1 vs stage-3 announcement filtering.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1353 lines — repeated recommendation to split into routers (auth, admin, master, content [courses/modules/lessons/announcements], lives, permissions, notifications, passport, ai).
start_live iterates async for m in db.users.find(q) then awaits notify() per member — for large stages this could be slow. Consider bulk insert of notifications.

can_edit and require_perm bypass ownership for role 'mestre'. Good, but there is no explicit permission-check on POST /courses/list side (list_courses admins/formadores see ALL drafts including of other formadores) — verify this is intended, otherwise filter by owner_id for non-master formadores.
PUT /master/formadores/{fid}/permissions silently drops unknown permission strings without any 400/warning. That is convenient but may hide typos from callers — consider returning the dropped list.
LessonPatch only allows title/content — no way for a formador with EDIT_LESSON to change duration_min, video_url, required, stage_order, or publish status. Confirm this is intentional.
seed_data_creation: During tests we temporarily promoted prevocacionado@caminho.app to role 'formador' (with only EDIT_LESSON / EDIT_ALL_CONTENT) to satisfy TESTE 3/4, then restored to role 'membro' (stage 1) and cleared its permissions. Demo formador's permission set is snapshotted per-session and restored after CREATE_COURSE / START_LIVE revoke tests. Extra TEST_* courses/modules/lessons/announcements/lives created during tests were cleaned from Mongo after Playwright run. Note: kelvinjose.oliveira@gmail.com (MESTRE) was found with blocked=true at start of the run (residue from previous brute-force lockout test in iteration <=5). Unblocked via direct DB update to allow login — this should be re-checked by main agent; consider auto-unblocking test accounts in seed or gating brute-force lockout out of test emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has iteration-6 classes appended after line 640. Key testids: profile-formador-panel, ann-title/ann-message/ann-submit, live-title/live-presenter/live-submit, start-{liveId}/end-{liveId}, former-live-{liveId}, master-perms-btn, perm-formador-{formadorId}, perm-{PERM_NAME}, perm-save, announcement-{id}. Frontend runs at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (mobile 390x844 layout). Login flow ends at /app (dashboard) — use `wait_for_function` on location.pathname.startsWith('/app') rather than pattern '**/app/**' (missed the exact '/app' route the first time). If MESTRE login returns 403 'Conta bloqueada', clear users.blocked in Mongo. Ensure DEMO formador ends up with the full set of demo permissions when leaving tests.
rca_of_the_issue: Pre-run: MESTRE account was blocked from prior brute-force lockout tests, causing session fixture to fail with 403 'Conta bloqueada'. Root cause: /api/auth/login blocks accounts after N failed attempts but seed does not un-block on restart. Mitigation applied: db.users.update_many({'blocked':True},{'$set':{'blocked':False}}). Recommend the developer either (a) exclude seeded test accounts from lockout, (b) unblock them on seed, or (c) auto-expire the block after a TTL.
